message: 九浄家の魔王

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me.」

name: Ria
message: 「What's going on, Sis?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is there something important you wanted to talk about?」

name: Helena
message: 「You've got pretty sharp instincts, don't you?」
Helena sips her black coffee.

name: Helena
message: 「It's about Re-Crea, which I mentioned before. Do you still remember?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Though, how should I put it... it doesn't really feel real, and I don't quite understand what's actually going to happen.」

name: Helena
message: 「Just hearing that shooting stars are falling doesn't really explain anything, does it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, this is the first time in my life I've ever seen so many of them falling.」

name: Helena
message: 「Right. Same for me. The last Re-Crea happened just a little before I was born, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then my mom and dad probably know about it too.」

name: Helena
message: 「The phenomena happening here in Ryuusei Town match almost completely with what we've heard from Mother. It's definitely Re-Crea.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Sis... are you thinking of telling Synn about that thing?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes.」

name: Helena
message: 「When Re-Crea draws near, demons start coming and going in the Human World much more frequently, right? Whether it's to take advantage of that or not, I don't know, but--」

name: Ria
message: 「A certain someone always makes an appearance in the Human World.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You mean...」

name: Helena
message: 「The Demon Lord.」
Do these two know that I'm the Demon Lord?
Did they call me here like this because they know?
And knowing that, what are they planning to do with me?
I catch my breath in tension.

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Sis, are you teasing Synn again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「You're making a serious face for once, so he's totally startled. Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Er, uh, well...」
People who usually fool around are way more intimidating when they get serious, after all.

name: Helena
message: 「Well, I suppose that's true.」
Helena-san let out a long, deep sigh.

name: Ria
message: 「Here. Have some tea and relax♪ It's not that tense of a topic.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Thank you very much.」

name: Ria
message: 「If anything, it might just leave you dumbfounded.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh...」
Either way, it didn't seem like I'd been dragged here to be grilled about being the Demon Lord.
Still, having the Demon Lord suddenly brought up as soon as I got here nearly gave me a heart attack.

name: Ria
message: 「I mentioned at the start that our Kujou family has protected the Rosary for generations, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「It has been passed down for a staggering number of years. That means a fair number of stories regarding Re-Crea have been preserved and handed down as well.」

name: Ria
message: 「And you see, the one who almost always shows up in those stories is--」

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon Lord, I take it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Precisely. Don't you feel like tracing the Demon Lord's existence would naturally unravel the mysteries of Re-Crea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's bound to be some kind of connection.」

name: Helena
message: 「Reports already indicate at this stage that this upcoming Re-Crea will have the largest impact in history.」
The historic Kujou family, indeed. Maybe they had some kind of confidential agency investigating Re-Crea behind the scenes.

name: Ria
message: 「And so, I want the members of the Student Council to know even a little bit about Re-Crea... and about the Demon Lord.」
I definitely wanted to know what kind of existence the Demon Lord actually was.
Picturing my dad didn't really help me wrap my head around it, and asking him would just get me another obnoxious bat message.

name: Synn
message: 「But if it's something that important, why only tell me?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's... um...\s03」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you want to know about the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Helena
message: 「Splendid! In response to that eager answer, I shall tell you the tale of the Demon Lord passed down in our Kujou family!」

name: Helena
message: 「His name is M☆A☆O\s07H♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Demon Lord♪ Demon Lord♪」

name: Helena
message: 「He's got a slick back view, M☆A☆O\s07H!」

name: Ria
message: 「Demon Lord! Demon Lord!」

name: Helena
message: 「He's cool, yet a little bit bad. That's what makes him so awesome, M☆A☆O\s07H♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Hi, hi.」

name: Helena
message: 「Grasping the fate of the world in his hand, clenching his fist for a Big Bang♪」

name: Ria
message: 「BANG, BANG.」

name: Helena
message: 「Friend or foe, the dark hero♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Sweep me away again today.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「That mysterious, cool guy is M☆A☆O\s07H.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is M☆A☆O\s07H.」

name: Helena
message: 「--And that's basically how it goes.」
Whoa, and it didn't even have a punchline...

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me that was actually the legend of the Demon Lord passed down in the Kujou family?」

name: Helena
message: 「Believe it! This is what you call tradition.」
Ria-senpai is looking down, blushing while eating a kashiwa mochi. Don't tell me she was bribed.
Still, I'm starting to have even less of a clue what kind of clan the Kujou family actually is.

name: Helena
message: 「Well, I actually just made that up for fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「*Slip*」

name: Helena
message: 「The lyrics themselves are true, though. That's what Mother told me.」

name: Synn
message: 「It kinda sounds like she only remembered what he looked like, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, when you see a handsome guy, you can't really help reacting like that, right~」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sure the previous Demon Lord... must have been such a dandy, wonderful gentleman~~\s04」
Helena's eyes are sparkling, swooning like a schoolgirl despite her age.
Does 'the previous Demon Lord' really mean Dad... in that case?
Would she be disappointed if she found out who he actually is?
...Wait a second?
Does that mean Ria-senpai's mom actually knew my dad?

name: Synn
message: 「Um... well! Do you... know the Demon Lord's name?」

name: Helena
message: 「The Demon Lord is just the Demon Lord, right? Though maybe 'Demon' is the surname and 'Lord' is the given name.」

name: Ria
message: 「Apparently things weren't all that bad last time, so it ended without anyone really finding out who the Demon Lord was.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's how it was.」
In the end, not much useful information was left behind regarding the Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, to think that you admire the Demon Lord, Helena...」

name: Helena
message: 「Because he is just totally, spot-on my type~~\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Isn't that just your own idealized fantasy, Sis? He only looked that way--you don't know if he was actually like that.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, are you sure you should be saying things like that?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Wawah! I'm sorry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I-I-It's nothing!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Well, that's just how it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know what 'how it is' means, but... well, this was helpful.」
At the very least, it doesn't seem like they have a bad impression of the Demon Lord.
Helena is... well, like that, and Ria-senpai doesn't seem to detest him all that much either.
Maybe both sisters are actually secret groupies of the Demon Lord.
Just knowing that puts me at ease. With this, even if I get found out as the Demon Lord, maybe I won't get expelled.
Still...

name: Helena
message: 「You're the Demon Lord? Not even close! You're neither suave nor a bad boy at all!」

name: Helena
message: 「Lying just to get on my good side is seriously the lowest. Therefore, you're expelled!」
Eeeek! Surrounded on all sides either way!
Anyway, I'd better hide my identity until I can become the kind of Demon Lord Helena talks about.
Though I don't know if I ever can\s01
